top_choice_rationale: P001 pairs two distinct, cleanly attributed achievements within three names: Pd-catalyzed C-N coupling (Buchwald, Hartwig), a ligand-controlled general method with a mechanism understood step by step and 25+ years of independent confirmation, and base editing (Liu), a designed chemical conversion of a single base without strand cleavage that is distinct from the 2020 cutting prize. It is the only slate proposal with five-member support and each part stands on its own scientific merit, though the pairing is pragmatic and Kosugi's priority and the omitted base-editing contributors must be recorded in the report.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; my research on proton and electron transfer is adjacent to B030, which is not on the slate, and Xiaodong Zou is a Stockholm University colleague whose proposal (P002) is ranked below P001
